name: Bacolod Speedcubing Open 2017

venue.name: CityMall Mandalagan
venue.address: CityMall Mandalagan, Lacson St, Bacolod, Negros Occidental

information: The competition is open to all interested cubers. This is the third speedcubing competition in the island of Negros. Payment details are emailed within 7days once pre-registration is complete. Kindly follow the instructions as emailed. When doing pre-registration, be sure to accurately list your list of guests.
